summary: Sandbox rows: measured in the cloud sandbox with real WebRTC calls from headless Chromium using a fake microphone (synthesised customer speech). The sandbox blocks WebSockets, so those runs used the HTTP fallbacks: Groq Whisper (speech-to-text after each pause) and Deepgram HTTP text-to-speech. Local rows: Deepgram smoke tests on the owner's machine in India on 12 November 2026, where streaming works; Deepgram's servers are in the US, so each request costs about 200 ms more than from the sandbox. End-of-speech to first audio with a real microphone is still to be measured (evals/results/voice-calls.jsonl).

measurements.Filler line when a slow system is called: spoken, about 2.6 s after end of speech
measurements.Barge-in: assistant stops after the cust: about 1.2 s (0.8 s sustained-speech rule + VAD)
measurements.Speech-to-text streaming, local (Deepgra: works; 5 partial results while speaking, final transcript correct ('Your next EMI of 12,450 rupees is due on the December 5.')
